mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate below 0.25% indicates accommodative monetary policy that lowers discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS remains below 0.25%, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in unemployment rate below 4.5% signals tight labor market conditions that boost consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: When UNRATE drops below 4.5%, S&P 500 fails to deliver positive 5-day returns in more than 55% of cases, or Rank IC remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in residential construction (HOUST) and consumer spending (RSAFS) indicates strong household demand that accelerates corporate revenue growth, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: When both HOUST and RSAFS show growth, S&P 500 fails to produce positive 60-day returns in more than 55% of instances, or interaction term Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Declining industrial production below 95.0 signals manufacturing weakness that triggers recession fears, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When INDPRO falls below 95.0, S&P 500 fails to produce negative 20-day returns in more than 55% of cases, or Rank IC remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Core inflation exceeding 2.5% annualized (CPIAUCSL YoY change) signals persistent inflation that may prompt aggressive monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: When CPIAUCSL YoY change exceeds 2.5%, S&P 500 fails to deliver negative 5-day returns in more than 55% of instances, or Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Sustained non-farm payrolls growth above 150,000 jobs per month indicates robust labor market conditions that support consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: When PAYEMS exceeds 150,000, S&P 500 fails to produce positive 60-day returns in more than 55% of cases, or Rank IC remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Robust GDP growth exceeding 2.0% annualized (GDPC1) signals economic expansion that supports corporate profit growth, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When GDPC1 growth exceeds 2.0% annualized, S&P 500 fails to deliver positive 20-day returns in more than 55% of instances, or Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in industrial production (INDPRO) and rising unemployment (UNRATE) indicate dual supply-labor market shocks that escalate recession risks, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: When INDPRO declines and UNRATE rises simultaneously, S&P 500 fails to produce negative 5-day returns in more than 55% of cases, or interaction term Rank IC is below 0.03.
